title: The suite runs the validate gate and fails the pipeline on any non-zero exit
asA: reviewer opening a pull request against the default branch
iWant: the pipeline to have already run `rcf validate` against the head commit's tree and refused the run on any schema or reference issue
soThat: I never review a change whose chain is structurally broken

acceptanceCriteria.description: The suite invokes `rcf validate` before any other gate. The gate's exit code, captured stdout, and captured stderr are written to a per-gate report at the configured stable path.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the pipeline has run against the head commit
acceptanceCriteria.when: the reviewer opens the per-gate report file at `<reportDir>/validate.json`
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file exists, its `gate` field is `validate`, its `command` field names the `rcf validate` invocation, its `exitCode` field records the underlying process exit code, and its `stdout` and `stderr` fields carry the captured streams

acceptanceCriteria.description: A non-zero exit from `rcf validate` marks the aggregate verdict as failed and the aggregate exit code as non-zero. The pipeline does not proceed to declare the run passed on the basis of downstream gates alone.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an invocation of the suite against a tree that fails `rcf validate` (a deliberately broken reference)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the aggregate report's `verdict` field is `failed`, its `gates[]` entry for `validate` records `outcome: failed`, and the Node entry point's process exit code is non-zero
